facts.summary: Ambrx paused internal ARX788 development and seeks an ex-China partner · Phase 2 · ARX788 in HER2+ metastatic breast cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Ambrx has recently paused the internal development of ARX788 and is seeking to partner ARX788 outside of China.
evidence.safety: None of the patients experienced drug-related serious adverse events (SAEs) and all adverse events (AEs) were well tolerated with no treatment discontinuations from AEs.
evidence.program_discontinued: Ambrx has recently paused the internal development of ARX788 and is seeking to partner ARX788 outside of China.
